enemy-045-seegson-security.designLock: Seegson Security directly targets the shipped Alien: Isolation light industrial station-security identity, but depicts one new unnamed human guard rather than a copied NPC. Preserve ordinary adult human proportions, a visible face under one open-faced off-white riot helmet with raised clear visor, pale blue-gray station work shirt, compact dirty off-white chest protector, dark gray work trousers, black utility boots and gloves, small radio and lamp, and one worn utilitarian pump-action security shotgun. The guard is civil/private station security, not a Colonial Marine, Working Joe, sealed corporate commando or modern police operator. Palette stays off-white, pale blue, gray, black and restrained worn-metal brown in the game's 1970s lo-fi retrofuturist material language. The shotgun remains one coherent tube-fed weapon across all clips; reload must show individual shells entering the loading port and must not reuse the queue placeholder's detachable-magazine wording. Strict right-facing orthographic gameplay profile, complete body and shotgun isolated per cell. Future pixels must be an original fan-made interpretation based on studied shape language, never a trace or copy of a game frame, concept sheet, artbook image, logo or official sprite.

externalEvidence.allowedUse: Primary positive source for era, material, silhouette and station-equipment grammar. No displayed concept image may be downloaded, traced or copied.

externalEvidence.allowedUse: Shipped-game human-threat context and Working Joe exclusion only; it does not authorize a specific copied NPC or bitmap.

topology.rule: Both hands remain anatomically connected and operate the same single shotgun. Helmet, raised clear visor, chest protector, radio, lamp and all limbs remain attached through every pose.

referenceLock.silhouette: Ordinary adult human station guard, lightly protected rather than militarized: open-faced riot helmet, compact chest plate, work shirt/trousers, utility belt and one pump shotgun held clear of the torso.
referenceLock.armorAndPalette: Pale blue-gray woven work shirt; dirty off-white/yellowed plastic chest protector and helmet; charcoal-gray trousers; black boots/gloves; restrained dull steel and brown wear. No saturated neon, camouflage or glossy modern polymer armor.
referenceLock.faceAndHelmet: One new, non-celebrity adult face remains visible. Off-white open-faced riot helmet and raised clear visor stay identical across all clips; no gas mask, sealed visor or Working Joe facial traits.

weapon.finish: worn charcoal metal, dark simple stock and muted utilitarian fittings
weapon.requiredRead: One coherent receiver, fixed stock, tubular magazine, fore-end pump and short unobstructed barrel; no optics or military launcher.
weapon.reloadLogic: Individual shells move from the belt/hand into the underside loading port; the pump chambers the weapon before ready. No detachable box magazine appears.

referenceLock.facing: Strict right-facing orthographic gameplay side view in all 40 future poses; shotgun muzzle points right and never toward camera.

scale.gameplayRole: Lightly protected ordinary human security unit in npc-standing gameplay class.
scale.rigidLandmark: Measure helmet crown-to-boot standing height and fixed butt-to-muzzle shotgun length in comparable ready poses.
scale.forbiddenMetric: Do not scale from muzzle flash, loose shells, recoil reach, clear visor edge, corpse width or total pose bounding box.

rootAndGround.pivotStatus: queue precedent only; requires pose-by-pose physical-foot review after generation
rootAndGround.bodyRoot: Project pelvis mass to the support plane; the shotgun never defines the anchor.
rootAndGround.livePoses: At least one boot carries credible load; no skating, tiptoe hover or stance widening caused by per-frame rescale.
rootAndGround.death: Terminal root lies below the collapsed pelvis/torso, not below the shotgun muzzle or a loose shell.

sourceContract.background: true transparent RGBA or perfectly uniform opaque #FF00FF
sourceContract.cellIsolation: Exactly one complete guard and the complete single shotgun per cell; no limb, muzzle, shell or equipment crosses a cell boundary.
sourceContract.identityScale: One face, outfit, helmet, chest plate, shotgun and scale across idle, move, attack, death and reload.

move.rule: Cautious station patrol gait with shotgun controlled in both hands; no military sprint, hip-fire bob or cell translation.

attack.rule: One readable pump-shotgun firing cycle. Any tiny attached muzzle flash remains subordinate and never changes anatomy, scale or cell isolation.

death.rule: Irreversible human collapse. Shotgun may settle beside the body but may not vanish, multiply, float or become the body anchor.

poses: shotgun cants to expose loading port
reload.rule: Weapon-specific tube reload with at most one loose shell visible at a time. No detachable magazine and no shotgun redesign.

prohibitions: No Working Joe, synthetic pallor, glowing eyes, rubber android suit or android anatomy.
No Colonial Marine M3 armor, Weyland-Yutani APEsuit, sealed corporate commando, SpecOps/ODST armor or modern SWAT kit.
No fully enclosed helmet, gas mask, mirrored face shield, riot shield, camouflage, neon cyberpunk police or glossy contemporary tactical nylon.
No automatic rifle, M41A, smartgun, energy rifle, optic, suppressor, launcher, bayonet, second firearm or weapon morphing.
No giant readable Seegson wordmark, copied logo, copied NPC face, invented unit number, text, scenery, floor, cast shadow, UI or watermark.
No left-facing, frontal or three-quarter pose, muzzle toward camera, crop, cell contact or copied official/licensed bitmap.
